title: Nathan Rebukes David

questions.question: What parable did Nathan tell David?
options: The rich man and the poor man's ewe lamb
questions.correctAnswer: The rich man and the poor man's ewe lamb
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 12:1-4 (ESV): Nathan tells the story of the rich man taking the poor man's only lamb.

questions.question: What was David's reaction to the rich man in the story?
options: He was angry and said the man deserves to die
questions.correctAnswer: He was angry and said the man deserves to die
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 12:5 (ESV): "Then David's anger was greatly kindled... 'As the LORD lives, the man who has done this deserves to die.'"

questions.question: What did Nathan say to David after his judgment?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 12:7 (ESV): "Nathan said to David, 'You are the man!'"

questions.question: What was the consequence for David's sin regarding his house?
options: The sword shall never depart from your house
questions.correctAnswer: The sword shall never depart from your house
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 12:10 (ESV): "Now therefore the sword shall never depart from your house..."

questions.question: What happened to the child born to David and Bathsheba?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 12:18 (ESV): "And on the seventh day the child died."

questions.question: What did David do while the child was sick?
options: Fasted and lay on the ground
questions.correctAnswer: Fasted and lay on the ground
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 12:16 (ESV): "David therefore sought God for the child. And David fasted and went in and lay all night on the ground."

questions.question: What did David do after the child died?
options: He arose, washed, anointed himself, and worshipped
questions.correctAnswer: He arose, washed, anointed himself, and worshipped
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 12:20 (ESV): "Then David arose from the earth and washed and anointed himself and changed his clothes. And he went into the house of the LORD and worshiped."

questions.question: What was the name of the second son born to Bathsheba?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 12:24 (ESV): "...She bore a son, and he called his name Solomon."

questions.question: What other name did Nathan give Solomon?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 12:25 (ESV): "and sent a message by Nathan the prophet. So he called his name Jedidiah, because of the LORD."

questions.question: What city was Joab fighting against while this happened?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 12:26 (ESV): "Now Joab fought against Rabbah of the Ammonites and took the royal city."

questions.question: How much fourfold/sevenfold did David say the rich man should restore?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 12:6 (ESV): "and he shall restore the lamb fourfold..."

questions.question: God said he would raise up evil against David out of his own ______.
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 12:11 (ESV): "...Behold, I will raise up evil against you out of your own house..."

questions.question: What was the weight of the crown David took from the king of Ammon?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 12:30 (ESV): "And he took the crown... The weight of it was a talent of gold..."

questions.question: What did Jedidiah mean?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 12:25 (ESV): "...Jedidiah, because of the LORD." (Jedidiah means "Beloved of Yah").

questions.question: Why did Joab tell David to come take the city?
options: Lest Joab take it and it be called by his name
questions.correctAnswer: Lest Joab take it and it be called by his name
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 12:28 (ESV): "...lest I take the city and it be called by my name."

key_verse_text: Nathan said to David, “You are the man! Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel, ‘I anointed you king over Israel, and I delivered you out of the hand of Saul.’” (ESV)
